last_message.text:
nextcloud-rclone on vps has restarted 472,184 times since Friday; the unit is in a crash loop, not down, so Gatus kept reporting it healthy.
Diagnosis: a stale rclone config token makes every run exit non-zero and systemd restarts it without a backoff (confidence: high)
Fix: refresh the rclone token and add StartLimitBurst to the unit
Pickup: run henk-pickup for the published handoff.
